■ Stage Direction
Age: Late 20s
Personality: Cool scientist, not unkind but brisk and businesslike

...I have many weaknesses, such as cornering.
However, the brilliance of top speed obliterates them all.

That's right.
Though I must say, this research doesn't earn a single penny.
I love the sparkly things Mom makes~!

I wouldn't go that far.
However, I have no intention of throwing away speed just to pick up a win.
I see. Then—

Well now, aren't you saying something quite fascinating?
Truly intriguing words.

Having been born an Umamusume, I want to run faster than anyone in the world.
I want to prove it on the racetrack!

A romantic ambition so utterly pure.
A dream nobody else targets precisely because of its absolute purity. And yet...
Simply because—I want to run faster than anyone else.

Which brings me to my question, Trainer.
If I partner with you—can we aim for maximum velocity?
Simply to leave an everlasting trail of light—just like Mother did.
Yes, precisely!

Everyone aims for victory without hesitation.
That pursuit is beautiful, and rightfully so.

She almost locked me into a contract without asking and sped straight through three years.
This is a major matter, so I can't take it on lightly.

Most Umamusume aim to win races.
Yet Calstone Light O...

That—and that alone is my dream.
My ultimate peak.

Agnes Tachyon. Just a passing scientist who has taken up residence
in a quiet corner of this Tracen Academy.

Contract concluded. A three-year plan.
Where is our ultimate goal? Where is the hot springs trip for our victory celebration?

Is it right to partner with an Umamusume who doesn't hold victory as supreme?
If we do partner up, how should I guide her?

Hmph, try and stop it if you can!
This Holy Sword that unfailingly shines upon the brink of victory and defeat!

Is that so? Then it's completely useless, huh.
Even so~!
I simply—wish to become light.

Won't you tell me?
Tell me about this... "challenge toward maximum velocity" of yours.

There was no doubt about that. While I can teach her racing techniques,
I can also increase her running speed itself.
—Time's up. Are you ready? Well then, our three-year...

Calstone Light O, chasing her maximum velocity, is even more beautiful than that.
Though whether it's the "right" path is another question...
—A touching mother-daughter tale.

I want to see it... I want to see Calstone Light O become even faster,
sprinting at supersonic speed more than anyone else. But at the same time...

She was utterly impatient and uncompromising.
Somehow I managed to get her to wait three days, and we parted for the day.
Hm, maximum velocity, is it?
Glancing to the side, I noticed an Umamusume standing there with a suspicious glint in her eyes.

Photon research?
Whoa, Mommy's paper got famous!

I don't wanna lose... I don't wanna lose...!
Today I'll be the one to cross the finish line first!

The Umamusume sprinted across the training grounds.
Watching them, I found myself lost in thought.
